Evidence strongly supports execution-limit stop, but the exact attachment itself is absent from saved transcript.

Revision used 22 Edit, 7 Read, 7 Grep, 5 Bash and 2 Glob calls. Two Bash scope denials, one actual failing coverage check and two replacement-string misses added work. Input context grew from 11,355 to 66,017 tokens; history replay, not new document output, dominates total usage.

Final passing check alone cannot prove this mapping is semantically adequate; no joint Verify happened.
